source_rules.equity_comment: the source says the acceleration step could be 0.01 for equities
source_rules.position: long/cash based on real SAR below/above current close
source_rules.reversal: signed trend duration changes sign when current high/low crosses the constrained recursive SAR; real SAR uses prior extreme point on reversal

defects_and_ambiguities: Uptrend initialization uses the prior high and downtrend initialization the prior low, opposite the usual below/above-price SAR placement described by the source.
The zero-initialized first real-SAR row creates a synthetic initial long position before enough recursive state exists.
The equity comment does not explicitly say whether 0.01 changes only the increment or also the initial factor; Batch 24 predeclares both as 0.01 and retains the 0.20 cap.
Current high and low are used to identify a reversal, but the source does not distinguish completed-bar signal observation from an executable next-period order.
Raw unadjusted OHLC makes the recursive path vulnerable to splits and other scale discontinuities.
Chained indexing, deprecated data dependencies, no tests, no costs, and no performance or uncertainty calculation prevent direct reuse.
independent_treatment: Preserve the source recursion and real-SAR convention after split-safe OHLC transformation. Ignore the invalid first-row position, apply signals next close, and test fixed default and equity acceleration variants with controls and portfolio gates.
